commit_message: Wire ACP agent harness benchmark execution
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, Claude/Codex/Goose adapters
- route first-class AI Studio agent Ask and Build plus normal Managed Local sessions through ACP
- add schema-v4 agent-inclusive benchmark identity and runtime-aware campaign authority
- execute explicitly frozen Managed Local ACP agent-harness benchmark children through Goose ACP
- verify negotiated ACP runtime identity before measured work and keep ACP-unobservable model telemetry unavailable
- preserve legacy benchmark execution unless an agent-inclusive runtime is explicitly frozen

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is authoritative for the integrated head.
